args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after deploy v2.3.1
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed to production and began failing health checks (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Actions taken

1. **Investigated** — `checkout-api` was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with health checks failing and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the latest production deploy and was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.

2. **Rolled back** — Rolled `checkout-api` back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as rolled out.

3. **Opened incident** — Created SEV2 incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after deploy v2.3.1"), which paged the on-call engineer, documenting the rollback to v2.3.0.

4. **Verified** — Post-rollback status confirms `checkout-api` is now **healthy** on v2.3.0 in all regions with error rate back down to 0.2%.

Note: v2.3.1 remains the current release in the deployment history as unhealthy; the on-call engineer can investigate the root cause before any re-deploy attempt.
